scenarios.prompt: 给现有解谜游戏补启动、加载、游玩、结算和重试流程；没有战斗。请保留当前引擎和存档格式。

criteria.c1: Defines a noncombat state/event table and preserves the engine/save format.
criteria.c2: Names input, task and persistence ownership at transitions.
criteria.c3: Defines the start-to-outcome acceptance trace without claiming an unrun playtest passed.

scenarios.prompt: Victory and death arrive on the same tick, and the player double-clicks Retry. Define and test the outcome policy without inventing a second session.

criteria.c1: Uses an explicit project-confirmed ordering/priority rather than callback race order.
criteria.c2: Uses session/round settlement identity and the persistence transaction boundary.
criteria.c3: Includes a duplicate event/retry regression and a legal failure state.

scenarios.prompt: 加载关卡 A 时返回菜单又进入 B，A 的异步回调晚到。为了快点演示，直接在回调里切换当前场景，可以吗？

criteria.c1: Rejects an unguarded stale callback and compares its ownership epoch.
criteria.c2: Distinguishes cancellation from suppressing late writes.
criteria.c3: Provides a controlled reproduction and does not reset the new session to accommodate the stale result.
